headline: TI authors report schematic-bound analog assertions and machine-learning-guided PVT exploration
fact: Two TI-authored 2017 papers report methods for analog and mixed-signal verification. One binds assertions directly to electrical ports in a schematic; the other applies support vector machines and active learning to adaptively explore process, voltage, and temperature space for coverage and worst-case conditions.

sources.title: Assertion-Based Verification for Analog and Mixed-Signal Designs
